title: Are “Write for Us” backlinks helpful in SEO?
author: Buzz Tum
contentHtml:
In fact, if you’ve been involved in SEO or content marketing for any amount of time, you are likely to have stumbled across the term ‘Write for Us’ backlinks. These backlinks are realized from the guest blogging sources that are earned from “Write for Us” pages where site owners, provide an open call for writers to submit articles for publication.


Now, let us take a closer look at the concept of guest blogging, backlinks, and SEO so that one can appreciate the meaning of “Write for Us” invitations.

Understanding the “Write for Us” Backlinks? 

“Write for Us” backlinks can be considered editorial backlinks since they are created by guest posting on other sites. All sorts of blogs or websites have pages titled something to the effect of ‘Write for Us’ or something like that. In return, authors get paid, and for SEO professionals and digital marketers, it is the availability of a backlink to the author’s website. 

Having backlinks is very important to SEO. They behave like transfers of votes from one site to another and tell search engines like Google that your site is credible. It was seen that the indexing of a site was positively affected when it had more quality and relevant backlinks. 

But is this also the case for the “Write for Us” backlinks? Let’s break it down. 

Now we will explain more about the importance of backlinks in SEO and what advantages the “Write for Us” backlink provides. Linking is one of the most important factors when it comes to website ranking on the search engine. If, for instance, your site is associated with that of a reputable site, then Google, Bing, or other search engines know that your site holds valuable content. This can, in turn, result in increased rankings, traffic, and popularity. 

How to Ensure Safe Backlinks by Guest Posting?

It is important to note that guest blogging has several risks for backlinks, but they shouldn’t be issues if the best practices are followed. Here’s how to maximize the SEO benefits of “Write for Us” backlinks: 

Choose High-Quality Websites 

It’s crucial to understand and remember that all the sites inviting to ‘Write for Us’ are not genuine. Concentrate on the website with good DA, closely relating to the topic of focus and a considerable audience.  To measure the authority of the site, use Moz’s Domain Authority checker or Ahrefs Domain Rating.

Create High-Quality, Valuable Content 

While posting as a guest, always make sure that the material you post on the site is as useful, helpful, and researched as possible. It is conspicuous that good content not only appeals to the owner of the site where the backlink is placed but also to the readers, social networks, and other users, which will add more value to the backlink.

Over Use Anchor Text 

As much as you should use your keywords in the text of the post, it is unadvisable to use the same anchor text for all the guest post backlinks. Do not act as if you have to force those keywords into an anchor text; rather, use natural variations. This will assist you in ensuring that you do not fall foul of the link penalty while keeping your link profile clean.

Diversify Link-Building Strategy 

Although guest blogging is good, it cannot be relied on as the only way of link-building. Also, identify other ways to obtain backlinks from other sources for example partnerships, social media optimization, online directories, and outbound link requests. 

Long-Term Goals 

SEO is actually a long journey and therefore guest blogging is the same. One must realize that seeing an influx of traffic from “Write for Us” backlinks will not happen as quickly as one might have hoped.

Closing Remarks

Building links is an important parameter in the field of SEO. One of the common types is guest blogging. You can approach the web owners of the best of your niche by direct email or by their invitation to write for us on the “Write for Us” page. Through safe and wise guest blogging opportunities, you can take your SEO journey to the next level.
